description: What a detached group window (P7) needs beyond the default capability: to rename itself, and to put itself in front of other windows. The backend titles the window when it opens it, but a group renamed on the Settings page afterwards reaches the window as a configuration event, and the title is the only thing that tells four of these windows apart in the Dock. Its own file rather than a line in the default one, so that widening what a group window may do never silently widens the main window too.
